description: Pages when a camera has reported no motion EVENTS beyond its own staleness window while the rest of the fleet is active. REWORKED 2026-08-27. Three triggers: the onset edge; a change to the STALE SET (so an additional camera crossing its threshold raises a genuinely new card instead of silently rewriting an existing one); a boot trigger (neither the onset edge nor a set-change can fire at startup, so without it a restart-wiped card took up to the full re-assert period to return) and a slow 2-hourly re-assert purely to restore a card wiped by a restart. The re-assert used to run HOURLY, which produced 260 identical recreations against 3 real state transitions in 26 days and trained the reader to ignore the channel - behind 50 identical pages sat one genuinely broken camera and one physically misaimed one. The condition now reads the recorder-derived stale_count instead of the template entity's last_changed, so a restart no longer disarms it for the first hour. Read the page as an observation, not a verdict: under a 24/7-recording plan the camera still records to the cloud regardless.

triggers.value_template: {% set corr = state_attr('sensor.camera_motion_stale','corroboration') or {} %}{{ (corr.items() | selectattr('1.broken', 'defined') | selectattr('1.broken') | list | count) > 0 }}

data.title: 📷 No motion events: {% set st = state_attr('sensor.camera_motion_stale','stale') or [] %}{{ st | join(', ') if st else 'none' }}

conditions.value_template: {% set corr = state_attr('sensor.camera_motion_stale','corroboration') or {} %}{% set broke = corr.items() | selectattr('1.broken', 'defined') | selectattr('1.broken') | list | count %}{{ trigger.id in ['onset','setchange','proven'] or (trigger.id == 'boot' and broke > 0) }}

data.title: 📷 No motion events: {{ (state_attr('sensor.camera_motion_stale','stale') or []) | join(', ') }}
data.message: {% set corr = state_attr('sensor.camera_motion_stale','corroboration') or {} %}{% set broke = corr.items() | selectattr('1.broken','defined') | selectattr('1.broken') | map(attribute='0') | list %}{% if broke %}PROVEN event-path failure: {{ broke | join(', ') }}. {% endif %}{{ state_attr('sensor.camera_motion_stale','summary') }}
